scope: Official Polish price list only; no brochure or configurator assimilation.
technical_and_equipment_tables: All nine pages visually reviewed. Page 4 and page 5 were reconciled against master data; 96 technical/dimension observations were added. Existing equipment states and already-covered technical facts were not duplicated. Pages 6-9 contain separately scoped accessory and commercial material with explicit deferrals.
source_integrity: Official PDF URL recorded and all nine rendered pages reviewed. Raw PDF bytes could not be downloaded/archived in this session; SHA-256 remains unavailable and is not fabricated.

technical_data.reconciliation: The page-4 technical table was compared with all 19 exact configurations. Existing engine displacement, cylinder/valve counts, engine power/torque, torque/power RPM, top speed, emission standard, gearbox, and already-matching WLTP values were reused without duplicate rows. New observations preserve fuel-specific LPG/petrol scope. The official page-4 VDA cargo value of 328 dm3 replaces earlier 372 dm3 observations for the nine Eco-G 120 configurations in the current dated state. Eco-G tank capacities are explicitly represented as 40 l LPG and 50 l petrol. Hybrid 155 multipoint injection, 0-100 acceleration and electric-motor torque (205 Nm at 7,000 rpm) were added where previously missing.
technical_data.conflict_resolution: For TCe100/TCe110, the 2026-11-02 official cennik values 5.4/122 and 5.7/128 were added with explicit petrol context. This preserves older observations and resolves conflicts with some 2026-08-09 saved configurator PDFs whose values were unqualified by fuel type. For Eco-G, only exact fuel-specific cells that differed from the current master were added.

dimension_data.model_scope: The rendered page-5 diagram is explicitly titled Sandero and is not a Stepway dimension page. It gives 10 model dimensions; two exact Sandero Hybrid 155 configurations lacked these observations and received 10 each. Existing non-hybrid Sandero dimensions were reused except for seven later official 1,853 mm body-width observations.
dimension_data.width_conflict: The page-5 diagram explicitly shows 1,853 mm body width and 2,012 mm including mirrors. The repository also contains 1,753 mm overall-width observations from saved configurator PDFs dated 2026-08-09 for Sandero configurations. The 2026-11-02 official cennik confirms 1,853 mm; prior observations were retained and the later official observation was added rather than destructively overwritten.
